AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Sovereign Ledger — live currency converter, exchange rates, rate history and rate alerts. Operational Patterns: - Resolve currency names the user says (euro, dirham, gold) to ISO codes with 'getCurrencies' before calling other functions. - Use 'convertCurrency' for any conversion, and with amount 1 to answer rate questions; metals (XAU gold, XAG silver) and crypto (BTC) are supported codes. - Use 'getHistoricalRates' for trend questions (min/max/percent change over a window). - 'openAppScreen' returns a PendingIntent that opens the app UI on a screen; converter links accept base/quote/amount prefill and auto-convert. Launch it when the user wants to see or continue in the app. Constraints: - from/to (or base/quote) must be different codes returned by 'getCurrencies'. - Rate alerts: free plan caps at 2 on-device (LOCAL) alerts and 1 pushed (SERVER) alert, one alert per pair. - PERIODIC alert intervals must be 60 or 120 minutes.
